outcome: Mean contractile force (MCF) of uterine smooth muscle
Maximum amplitude of contractions (MAMP) of uterine smooth muscle
cohort: Myometrial biopsies from 11 women undergoing planned cesarean section at term (5 primiparous, 6 multiparous)
finding: Uterine smooth muscle from first-time mothers showed a significantly weaker contractile response to both oxytocin and ergometrine compared to muscle from women who had given birth before, suggesting potential implications for postpartum hemorrhage management in first-time mothers.
